title: Rosalind and the Harbor
author: Zephyrine Okonkwo
blurb: Elodie Galloway, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, has spent fifteen years learning which silences keep people safe. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
